rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the quality of being lazy, especially in more formal or general statements.

example.english: Their laziness caused the work to fall behind.
example.traditional: 佢嘅懶惰令工作進度落後。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 laan5 do6 ling6 gung1 zok3 zeon3 dou6 lok6 hau6

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun when laziness is presented as someone's habitual or inherent tendency.

example.english: My laziness has been there since I was little—I don't want to move whenever I'm on holiday.
example.traditional: 我自細就有懶性，一放假就唔想郁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi6 sai3 zau6 jau5 laan5 sing3 jat1 fong3 gaa3 zau6 m4 soeng2 juk1
